useCase: Analyzing frequency energy 分布 异常 in AI生成的 images
mechanism: It violently dismantles the image architecture, pulverizing the data into categorized bands via frequency transformation. It organizes scales from Low Bandwidth (smooth shadows, massive gradients), Medium, up to Ultra-High Frequency (microscopic organic spikes). Fraudsters never understand their execution because AI fundamentally always regurgitates heavily 'Fractured Bandwidth' (Violent imbalance between Base vs Detail scales). This algorithm cross-interrogates differing zones (host vs spliced). Instantly, grotesque frequency sheer-tears at the spectral peak bleed into the open.
accuracy: 中-高 - 75-85% as complementary frequency 分析
name: 频带分析
source: Frank et al. (2020) - Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition, ICML
parameters: Filter type: Butterworth order 4, Bands: low (0-0.1π), mid (0.1π-0.4π), high (0.4π-π), Metrics: band energy ratio, spectral centroid
description: Decomposes image into multiple frequency sub-bands using filter banks. AI生成的 images show anomalous energy 分布 跨 bands due to upsampling 伪影.

references.title: Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch Your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Deep Neural Networks Are Failing to Reproduce Spectral Distributions. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures frequency-domain signatures of different AI models
• Complements 空间域 分析
• Adjustable band parameters for different generators
• Relatively robust to 空间域 篡改s
limitations:
• Requires careful band parameter tuning
• JPEG压缩 affects high-frequency 分析
• Less distinctive for high-quality diffusion outputs
• Performance varies with image content type
